description.value:
Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

“In my country we have a saying. [医者と味噌は古いほど良い]; an old doctor and aged miso are best. Technology may reveal new horizons, but sometimes old methods are most reliable. The arm guards of samurai… created close to 1,000 years ago. Still effective today.” - Goro Takemura

SP13 or lower Body Armor Attachment. This attachment only functions while the armor has at least 1 SP. When the user would suffer the Broken Arm, Torn Muscle, or Crushed Fingers Critical Injury from a Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee Weapon Attack or Special Move, this enhancement negates the injury’s bonus damage entirely. Any options stored in a Cyberarm or meat arm that armor with a Kawan-Kote is being worn over are inaccessible while the armor is being worn. The Kawan-Kote cannot be concealed, but are not immediately suspicious to anyone that doesn’t know what they are.

Type: Armor Attachment (Body Armor, SP 13 or lower)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).
